# Manoj Airtel Wi-Fi Internet

> Authorized Airtel dealer in Sonipat, Haryana, India, operating since 2016. Provides Airtel Xstream Fiber and Airtel AirFiber broadband (speeds up to 1 Gbps), Airtel postpaid and corporate SIMs, and Internet Leased Line (ILL) solutions for homes, offices and businesses.

Service areas: Sonipat, Kundli, TDI Kingsbury, Gohana, Ganaur, Kharkhoda, Rai Industrial Area, Barhi, Murthal, and nearby areas in Haryana, India.

Door-to-door service: on a call or online booking, service is given at the customer's location; online booking also covers Panipat, Rohtak, Karnal, Kurukshetra and Hisar. Installation and the Wi-Fi router are free on every plan. The ₹1,500 advance is adjusted in the first three bills, and from the 3rd bill there is ₹100 off every bill for 10 months. The advance is paid directly to Airtel through Airtel's payment link or QR code; receipts and bills come from Airtel. Sonipat office open 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM daily.

Contact: Call or WhatsApp 9255820000. Sonipat office: Shop No. 13, 2nd Floor, Subhash Chowk, Municipal Colony, Ashok Nagar, Atlas Road, Sonipat, Haryana 131001. Kundli office: Shop No. 14, Dahiya Market, near Makhan Bhog, Kundli, Sonipat, Haryana 131028 (open 7:00 AM to 7:30 PM).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/): Overview of all services, plans and coverage areas.
- [Airtel Xstream Fiber](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/fiber.html): Wired fiber broadband plans, pricing and features.
- [Airtel AirFiber](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/airfiber.html): Wireless broadband plans for areas where fiber cabling isn't feasible.
- [Postpaid SIM & MNP](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/postpaid.html): Airtel postpaid plans from ₹499/month (new plans from 8 October 2026), family plans up to 5 SIMs, number porting (MNP) and Airtel Corporate Postpaid SIM connections for businesses (corporate section: https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/postpaid.html#corporate-postpaid).
- [Business Internet](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/business-internet.html): Internet Leased Line (ILL), static IP and B2B connectivity for offices and factories.
- [Plans](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/plans.html): Full comparison of all fiber and AirFiber plans.
- [Gallery](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/#gallery): Photos of installations, office and team.
- [Reviews](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/#reviews): Customer reviews.
- [FAQ](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/#faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Contact](https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in/#contact): Phone, WhatsApp, address and hours.
